display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
第3段：一次模型阶段
首次生成或任一轮 quality repair

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
按 2x2/2x4 读取本地 Design mock
不占真实模型令牌

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
OpenAI 复合后端
从配置的 master 开始

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
确定当前 provider 的调用预算
重试关闭：1 次
重试开启：master 1+M / fallback 1+F

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 一次真实物理调用进入 ModelExecutionRuntime

div.style: color: rgb(16, 29, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
请求共享 asyncio.Semaphore
model_max_concurrency 默认 20 / 每进程

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
无令牌：请求协程排队
不占线程，6 秒 heartbeat 仍可运行

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
排队超过独立的
model_queue_timeout_seconds
默认 120 秒？

div.style: color: rgb(59, 10, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MODEL_QUEUE_TIMEOUT
本次物理调用按模型异常处理

div.style: color: rgb(16, 29, 63) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
取得 1 个模型令牌
记录 queue_duration_ms

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MEP：httpx 异步流
网络等待不占 AnyIO 工作线程

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
DeepSeek Platform：异步 WebSocket
网络等待不占 AnyIO 工作线程

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
llmclient：专用 ThreadPoolExecutor
max_workers 默认同为 20
不占 AnyIO 默认线程池

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
执行超过独立的
model_request_timeout_seconds
默认 120 秒？

div.style: color: rgb(59, 10, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
MEP/DeepSeek：取消异步请求
抛 MODEL_REQUEST_TIMEOUT

div.style: color: rgb(59, 10, 8) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
llmclient：线程不能强制终止
继续持有模型令牌直到物理调用结束
丢弃迟到结果后抛超时

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
成功或异常都在 finally 释放模型令牌
记录 execution_duration_ms

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(7, 43, 22) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;
color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p: 当前 provider 还有模型异常重试预算？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
指数退避 + jitter 的 asyncio.sleep
不占模型令牌、不占线程

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
下一次尝试重新排队
不会连续独占模型令牌

div.style: color: rgb(58, 37, 0) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
OpenAI master 已耗尽，且
模型重试和 fallback 开关都开启？

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
切换 llmclient fallback
每次调用仍获取同一个共享令牌

div.style: color: rgb(59, 10, 8) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A2UI_GENERATION_FAILED
不进入转换、校验和保存

div.style: color: rgb(16, 29, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
并发统计范围
第三至第五接口、Create/Edit、首次生成、
模型重试、master/fallback、所有 repair

div.style: color: rgb(16, 29, 63) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
限制按进程生效
N 个 Uvicorn 进程理论总上限为 N × 20
